assumptions: SC01/GT04 casualty-work scheduling override (authored, uncalibrated; not catalog urgency): casualty_work_policy sets locally believed major/destroyed-building T014=82 above corroborated camera-candidate T027=81, T033=89 above T029=86, and T034=90 above new loading, below T035=91; T031=94 and all physical guards remain unchanged. A waiting proposed T014 is monotonically promoted once on delivered major/destroyed damage, clearing its old allocation retry delay without A050 or a new revision; later damage estimates remain unchanged and this promotion is not damage certainty. Other first-search priorities, uncertainty, observations and ordinary residents stay intact. At real action boundaries, queued substantive A053/A056/A057/A058 controls run before another old method/approach starts, and an in-flight commitment change holds that lane until its result; this neither instantly stops an active action nor releases occupancy. Assignments include the known person response/evidence for an exact belief.entity_ref alias, so existing stale-contact checks can cancel already resolved contacts through A054; no distance-only identity, mobile/uninjured-to-no-needs inference or truth role filter is introduced. A queued T014 is canceled as stale when a locally received belief.search_status=complete already resolves its building, including recheck before A008 after travel; this adds no search success and partial/inconclusive T015 remains eligible. Missing medical stock stays a real A019 failure: catalog A024 needs C24 and A028 needs C27; neither is granted to the specialist. Existing carrier transport and receiver-side T031 remain available. No payload, pickup range, receiver, road, hidden truth or capability is changed, and a rescue within 3600 s is not asserted without a run.

Shared camera allocation/contact policy (authored, uncalibrated; not catalog urgency): all scenes use T002=70, T014=70 (80 for locally believed major/destroyed damage), and established-human T027=78. A single-frame camera-candidate T027 stays <=64; person/human detections of the same locally associated candidate in >=2 distinct capture parent /image IDs from the same reporting agent promote its T027 to 81, above those surveys at a safe boundary. Raw/associated copies, duplicate boxes and replays of the same capture count once. An existing waiting proposed T027 is refreshed in-place once on promotion, without a new A050 or revision; timestamps and frame IDs are not proposal-signature changes. Camera-review T011 stays <=63. Failed candidate A009 sensor contacts suppress the same candidate or a locally recorded site within 3 m for 120 s and require camera presence evidence acquired after the failure before retry; failure does not establish human absence. These are shared defaults even without camera_search_policy; explicit existing overrides are honored, and regional search policies are unchanged. Existing commitments use authored policy fields F202/F209/F212 from 10_字段385; 05_任务96 and 14_场景任务映射 do not mandate task ordering. A coordinator-known accepted/executing commitment with a matching delivered current-task id/revision remains an allocator candidate, subject to priority, interruptibility, capability, access, payload and energy checks. Queued A052 and assignments awaiting delivery/acceptance remain reserved; unmatched current-task reports do not release them. A053 acceptance-to-deadline windows are not unconditional uninterruptible leases: replacement acceptance still waits for the real action boundary and A056 checkpoint, with A057 revalidation on resume. Equal-priority 81 contacts cannot interrupt each other. A queued camera T027 is canceled as stale through A054 only when its exact local candidate has a delivered belief.entity_ref and the referenced human needs are known without a contact need. Recheck before allocation/acceptance and before initial approach/A009, not after this task own successful contact; no distance-only identity or suppression of unassociated tracks. A059 services may preempt only a lower-priority executing preemptible ordinary commitment through the existing A053/A056 action-boundary checkpoint and A057 resume; active service scopes and real capability/access/energy/aboard constraints remain binding. Service A053 rechecks local commitments, and refusals retain busy/payload/access/energy/tool causes instead of all becoming capability failures. Fresh unassociated tracks can still starve lower-priority searches under this unchanged policy. No scene switch, truth, count, location, outcome or capability change is introduced. Survey-relative starvation is expected to be removed only when corroboration and real capability, access, energy and delivery permit; contact, rescue and fixed-horizon results are not guaranteed.

Camera re-sightings of an already contacted person (a local non-camera human with delivered contact needs) associate to that person when strict point-in-box and camera-track matches miss, using the same measured box tests: its contact foot point projected inside the box, else within the measured bottom-edge half-span around the box bottom-centre ground estimate. One-person-per-frame exclusion still applies. This prevents repeat contacts of the same known resident from minting new tracks; it never marks an uncontacted or unknown person absent and changes no truth, needs, urgency or capability.

A carrier with an unacknowledged person aboard does not accept (A053) or resume (A057) unrelated work such as contact, survey or clearance until that person is handed over; care, load, transport, handover and water-recovery tasks (T029-T036) still proceed. This applies the existing A059 service rule ("a team with a person aboard finishes that person's handover before serving anyone else") to ordinary tasks. A deferred commitment stays suspended, not failed; capacity, access, receiver and truth checks are unchanged.
Generated instance presence is not task completion; existing agent capabilities, beliefs, execution, logs and AAS plugin remain authoritative.

Compatibility authority: configs/asset_allocation.json scenes.SC01.rules. Mission provenance records explicit delivered-BASE human substitutions; missing assets are not fetched or credited as delivered variants.
Camera observation settings reuse SC01; task allowlists/capabilities remain scene-specific. Missing generated incident subjects or exact staffed facilities refuse explicitly.
